P0.label: CONTROL
P0.description: Exactly current V3 + production risk geometry: strategy top_n=8, max_positions=6, max_position_pct=0.10, maximum_allocation=0.60, max_gross=0.60, cash_buffer=0.40. Sizing remains current inverse residual-volatility sizing.

P1.label: DIVERSIFY_7
P1.description: V3 selection remains top_n=8. Risk geometry max_positions=7, max_position_pct=0.085. Maximum nominal equity exposure 7*0.085=0.595 approx same 60% sleeve. Position-count selection MUST preserve V3 alpha rank. Current inverse residual-vol sizing remains unchanged.
P1.note: One position cannot consume 10%. Same 60% sleeve, model-free diversification.

P2.label: DIVERSIFY_8
P2.description: V3 selection remains top_n=8. Risk geometry max_positions=8, max_position_pct=0.075. Maximum nominal equity exposure 8*0.075=0.60. All eight V3-selected names may survive risk overlay while single-name maximum exposure falls by 25%. Current inverse residual-vol sizing unchanged.
P2.note: 8*7.5% produces comparable return with lower tail risk if 7th/8th names not value-destructive.

P3.label: TAIL_ES_126
P3.description: Keep CURRENT concentration geometry max_positions=6 max_position_pct=0.10. Keep exact V3 alpha selection. Change ONLY sizing risk denominator. For every selected symbol calculate using information available strictly through decision timestamp: normal_risk = current production residual_volatility_63; Also calculate downside Expected Shortfall from split-adjusted daily PRICE returns over previous 126 completed sessions. tail_count=max(1,ceil(0.10*len(daily_returns))), worst_returns=tail_count most negative, ES10_daily=abs(mean(worst_returns)), tail_risk_equivalent=ES10_daily*sqrt(252), effective_risk=max(normal_risk,tail_risk_equivalent), raw_weight=1/effective_risk then EXISTING normalization and 10% cap. Do NOT alter rank, do NOT use future returns, do NOT use diagnostic MAE, do NOT optimize 126/10%/sqrt252 frozen. If fewer than 126 returns exist fallback to normal.

sizing.fallback: if fewer than 126 returns exist, use normal production residual-vol sizing

candidate_note: Do NOT grid-search. Evaluate EXACTLY P0-P3. Do NOT mix P1/P2/P3 initially. P1/P2 are model-free diversification changes, P3 is risk-estimation change. cost_stress.description: Each level independently RERUNS the full trading path with scaled engine cost inputs: slippage_bps*MULT, spread_bps*MULT, crypto_taker_fee_bps*MULT, and where applicable equity fee rates scaled similarly. No heuristic adjusted-return / adjusted-Sharpe formulas. Real engine reruns.
forbidden_heuristics: any linear fee subtraction without rerun

fold_contract.integrity: EVERY fold is an independent backtest run with its own warmup/state initialization. No fast_folds_from_curve, no equity-curve slicing, no heuristic fee transforms.

promotion_rubric.description: Candidate passes only if ALL 14 gates are true (§12). No lookahead, strategy identity preserved, exposure within band.
criteria: 2. Full-period return no worse than CONTROL by >5 percentage points (candidate_total_return >= control_total_return - 0.05).
3. Worst contemporaneous single-position account loss improves >=20% OR p99 position-account loss improves >=20% (candidate_worst >= control_worst * 0.80 in absolute terms, i.e., less negative).
4. Top-5 loss concentration does not worsen materially (candidate top5 concentration <= control top5 + tolerance, not materially larger).
6. Median paired 20-fold return delta >= 0 (candidate - control per fold median).
7. >=10/20 Sharpe folds beat CONTROL (candidate Sharpe > control Sharpe in at least 10 folds).
9. Real 3x-cost run preserves Sharpe >= CONTROL 3x OR remains within 0.02 with materially better tail metrics.
10. No one-year dependency (every single calendar year + exclude windows not dominated; candidate not critically dependent on one year).
11. No single-symbol dependency (candidate-specific own top-3 jackknife still satisfies gates 1-3).
12. Average equity exposure must remain within CONTROL +/-5 percentage points unless reduced exposure itself produces sufficiently higher Sharpe.
13. No lookahead (P3 ES strictly through decision timestamp, verified by construction and test).
14. Strategy selection/ranking identity unchanged (P3 alpha RANKING and selected names identical to P0; only final target weights differ — parity test).

interpretation.P1_P2: P1/P2 change portfolio-risk geometry, do NOT create new alpha. If 8x7.5% succeeds interpret as diversification/risk-policy improvement not new alpha. If 7th/8th names destroy returns report plainly. Do NOT afterwards try 7.8%/8.0%/8.2%/9 positions — no post-result grid.
interpretation.P3: If P3 fails do NOT test ES5/ES15/90d/180d after seeing results. Conclude predeclared estimator did not add value. If P3 succeeds run parity tests proving alpha RANKING and selected names identical to P0 only final target weights differ.
interpretation.combinations: Do NOT run P2+P3 in this mission. First establish whether either idea works independently. No combinatorial search.
